description: 繁體中文：Nivqo Manager 顯示版本維持 1.34.0，本次同版 replacement 更新 HushFacebook 至 0.7.2-nivqo.1（70 patches），保留 HushMessenger 0.21.0-nivqo.1（33 patches / 30 controls / 37 個 arm64 builds）。HushFacebook 核心繁中 609/609、Manager Facebook metadata 70/70；Nivqo Patches 更新至 0.5.0，共 103 patches。同時修正 Manager 離線首次啟動的 Messenger seed 路徑仍指向 0.14.0 的歷史問題，現在 APK 內建 Facebook 0.7.2 與 Messenger 0.21.0 seed。保留 Nivqo 品牌、app.nivqo.manager、自有更新通道、WorkManager 背景更新、繁中介面與 Facebook / Messenger 整合。 English: Nivqo Manager remains versionName 1.34.0 as an in-place replacement. HushFacebook is updated to 0.7.2-nivqo.1 (70 patches), while HushMessenger remains 0.21.0-nivqo.1 (33 patches / 30 controls / 37 arm64 builds). HushFacebook Traditional Chinese core coverage is 609/609 and Manager Facebook metadata is 70/70; Nivqo Patches 0.5.0 contains 103 patches total. This replacement also fixes the historical first-run offline Messenger seed path that still pointed to 0.14.0; the APK now bundles Facebook 0.7.2 and Messenger 0.21.0 seeds. Nivqo branding, package identity, update channels, WorkManager polling, localization, and Facebook/Messenger integration are preserved.
